label: Bible Study
prompt: The Spirit itself beareth _____ with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
verse: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
note: The Spirit confirms what we can barely believe — we really are God's children.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his _____: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
verse: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
note: Job's story ends better than it began — the latter end blessed more than the beginning.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many _____.
verse: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
note: John hears the risen Jesus' voice as the sound of many waters — think a thundering waterfall.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of _____ fruit:
verse: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
note: Amos wasn't a professional prophet — he was a shepherd who tended sycomore-figs until God called him.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast _____;
verse: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
note: David looked up at the moon and stars God had 'ordained' and asked, 'What is man?' Stargazing as theology.
